pairings.rationale: The bright, tangy flavor of preserved lemon will elevate the sweet, jammy notes of the Slow Tomato Confit, creating a harmonious balance that enhances both dishes.
Dukkah's nutty, spiced profile complements the mellow sweetness of the confit, adding a crunchy texture and layers of flavor that enhance the overall dish.
The smoky warmth of paprika will accentuate the rich, slow-cooked flavors of the tomato confit, providing depth and a touch of earthiness that fits well within Italian cuisine.
Mojo verde's fresh herbaceousness and subtle heat will contrast beautifully with the sweet tomatoes, creating a vibrant sauce that pairs well with both toast and pasta.
